# Creating a Flatpak for Flathub

To compile and distribute your Linux application as a Flatpak on Flathub, you'll need to follow these steps:

## 1. Set up your development environment

First, install the necessary tools:

```bash
# For Fedora/RHEL
sudo dnf install flatpak flatpak-builder

# For Ubuntu/Debian
sudo apt install flatpak flatpak-builder

# For Arch Linux
sudo pacman -S flatpak flatpak-builder
```

Add the Flathub repository:
```bash
flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists flathub https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
```

## 2. Create a Flatpak manifest

Create a JSON manifest file (e.g., `com.yourdomain.yourapp.json`) that describes how to build your application:

```json
{
    "app-id": "com.yourdomain.yourapp",
    "runtime": "org.freedesktop.Platform",
    "runtime-version": "23.08",
    "sdk": "org.freedesktop.Sdk",
    "command": "yourapp",
    "finish-args": [
        "--share=network",
        "--share=ipc",
        "--socket=x11",
        "--socket=wayland",
        "--filesystem=host"
    ],
    "modules": [
        {
            "name": "yourapp",
            "builddir": true,
            "buildsystem": "meson",
            "sources": [
                {
                    "type": "git",
                    "url": "https://github.com/yourusername/yourapp.git"
                }
            ]
        }
    ]
}
```

Adjust the manifest based on your application's requirements and build system.

## 3. Test building your Flatpak locally

```bash
flatpak-builder --user --install build-dir com.yourdomain.yourapp.json
```

Test your application:
```bash
flatpak run com.yourdomain.yourapp
```

## 4. Submit to Flathub

1. Create a GitHub repository with your Flatpak manifest and any additional files
2. Fork the [flathub/flathub](https://github.com/flathub/flathub) repository
3. Submit a pull request to the flathub repository

## 5. Flathub submission requirements

- Your app must have a proper AppStream metadata file
- Include a good quality application icon
- Follow the [Flathub guidelines](https://github.com/flathub/flathub/wiki/App-Requirements)
- Ensure proper desktop integration
